text:
Ava: FYI we just got an RFP from AuroraAI — they want Private (VPC) deployment, KMS/HSM integration, Terraform modules, and a 6-week POC cost breakdown. Questionnaire due EOD Fri.
Marcus: got it. do they require EU data residency or is region-agnostic?
Ava: EU only for prod, but POC can be in us-west. they flagged HIPAA-level controls + hardware-backed KMS.
Priya: I can start the capability matrix and RFI answers. I'll attach the matrix + SOC2 summary. link: https://drive.redwood/reports/auroraai-rfp 
Jin: putting together a sample terraform snippet for private deployers — minimal example below for the ops doc:
```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source    = "git::https://git.redwood.ai/terraform/ri-private.git?ref=v1.2"
  region    = "eu-west-1"
  kms_key_id = "arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/abcd-ef01"
  private_subnet_ids = ["subnet-01","subnet-02"]
}
```
Marcus: pricing ask from AuroraAI: they want both per-token hosted pricing and a reserved dedicated capacity quote (monthly commit) for the 6-week POC. asked for ballpark by EOD Thu.
Priya: I'll draft two options: 1) POC on hosted with tokens estimate + uplift for streaming, 2) Dedicated reserved GPU cluster for consistent latency with a flat monthly commit + overage.
Ava: they also asked for an ops/playbook attachment: can we include runbook for failover to smaller model + tracing hooks?
Jin: yes — include example routing policy snippet and canary rollback steps. I'll add latency SLO table.
SecurityBot: Checklist: provide KMS-HSM attestation, key-rotation policy, audit log sample, and network architecture diagram showing VPC endpoints. AuroraAI asked about HSM-backed KMS — confirm integration path and if we need on-prem HSM appliance.
Marcus: do we have a standard language for HSM integration in the RFP? legal-review, any red flags for shipping HSM connectors?
legal-review: main concerns: export controls, customer-supplied keys SLA, and liability for on-prem hardware. need DPA + amendment for HSM ops. please route drafts to contracts@redwood.
Ava: noted. Priya — add a DPA checklist item and mark legal to review before sending.
Priya: will do. I'll create two attachments: capability_matrix_auroraai.csv and aurora_poC_ops_playbook.pdf and upload before EOD Thu.
Marcus: for numbers, propose: hosted POC: estimate 15M tokens -> $X (breakdown in spreadsheet). Dedicated POC: reserve 2x A100-equivalent for 6 weeks -> monthly commit price + setup. I'll flesh out.
Ava: thanks. Marcus/Priya/Jin please sync for a dry-run of the RFP answers tomorrow 10am PT. I'll invite Aurora's technical contact afterwards.
Jin: added to my calendar. I'll also include the terraform module link and a minimal example repo.
Ava: quick ping — @legal-review, @SecurityBot, please add any must-have clauses or required certs by EOD Wed so we can include in the RFP package. :pray:
legal-review: will do, aim to send redlines by Wed 5pm.
SecurityBot: sending an itemized checklist (KMS attestation, SOC2, penetration test summary, data retention policy) by Wed midday.
Ava: perfect. thanks team — we'll close this out and send the package Thu afternoon unless anything urgent comes up.
